jobs.notes: Open-market graduate applications run 9:00am AEST Mon 22 Feb 2027 to 11:59pm Sun 4 Apr 2027, with interviews from 27 Apr 2027 and offers made 2 June 2027 (accept/decline by 1:00pm 3 June 2027); open to final-year students.

Allens' own graduates site states applications for the May 2027 Dive In program open in March 2027 but publishes only the month, so exact open and close dates are not confirmed; Allens' 2026/27 clerkship rounds in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane and Perth are all closed.
